verdict: Trane's revenue jumped 18% to $6.8B on Americas strength and a $12.5B backlog, lifting net profit to $1.0B even as margins slipped in EMEA and Asia Pacific.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: net revenues $6.76B vs $5.74B a year ago

segments.name: Americas
segments.note: Commercial and residential heating and cooling and Thermo King transport refrigeration in North and Latin America — up 21%, the engine of the quarter.

segments.name: EMEA
segments.note: Europe, Middle East and Africa — revenue up just 1%, with margins down on mix and costs.

segments.name: Asia Pacific
segments.note: Asia Pacific commercial systems and transport refrigeration — up 8%.

opex.name: Selling and administrative
opex.note: Selling heating, cooling and refrigeration systems and running the company — Trane's only operating-expense line.

takeaways.title: The Americas did the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Americas revenue rose 21% to $5,648M with a 21.9% operating margin, across commercial HVAC, residential and transport refrigeration. EMEA grew just 1% and Asia Pacific 8%, with margins down in both.

takeaways.title: Future work is piling up
takeaways.text: Bookings rose 21% to $7.2B — more than the quarter's revenue in every segment — and the backlog reached $12.5B, up 73%, with Americas commercial HVAC backlog up about 80%.

takeaways.title: Adjusted EPS rose 25%
takeaways.text: Adjusted continuing EPS was $4.86, up 25%, vs $4.79 GAAP continuing EPS. Year-to-date free cash flow was $2.8B, up about 60%, funding $930M of dividends, $1.1B of acquisitions and $1.4B of buybacks so far this year.

oneTimers: Pre-tax non-GAAP adjustments were $21M in the quarter: $16M of amortization of an acquired backlog intangible, $4M of restructuring costs and $1M of deal costs — the gap between GAAP operating income of $1,343M and adjusted operating income of $1,364M.
Discontinued operations lost $11M after tax in the quarter (legacy businesses in Chapter 11-related separation), reducing net EPS to $4.74 from $4.79 for continuing operations.
otherDetail: Net expense of $58M below operating income: $52M of interest expense plus $5M of other expense, net (rounded). Continuing operations earned $1,065M after $220M of tax; a $11M discontinued-operations loss and $5M earned by noncontrolling interests (shown together as -$16M) leave $1,049M attributable to Trane shareholders.
footerNote: Net income here is the $1,049M attributable to Trane Technologies plc (total net earnings were $1,054M). Amounts are rounded to the nearest $M from the release's $0.1M figures, so the discontinued-operations and noncontrolling-interest deduction is shown as $16M.
